title: 5.15.4 Debugging: The tail that never bites
description: Two planted bugs. The snake runs over its own body and keeps going. The search is there, but it asks the wrong question.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The snake crosses its own body and nothing happens.

steps.title: Bug 1: only the first segment is tested
steps.instructions: The check looks at `body[0]` instead of looping over every segment.

steps.title: Bug 2: it tests where the head is, not where it is going
steps.instructions: Compare against `nextX`/`nextY`, the cell the head is about to enter. Testing the current cell can never be true, because the head is not in the body yet.

requirements.title: Every segment is tested
requirements.description: A loop over the body checks each segment. Help: 5.15.1 (Reading: Searching the array)

requirements.title: The next cell is tested
requirements.description: The comparison uses the cell the head is about to enter. Help: 5.15.1 (Reading: Searching the array)
